newsitem.title: USA: Police draw blank on JonBenet lead in N. Carolina.
newsitem.headline: Police draw blank on JonBenet lead in N. Carolina.

text.p: A potential lead that took police investigating the murder of 6-year-old JonBenet Ramsey to North Carolina has turned up empty, officials said on Tuesday.
In a statement, Boulder police also said they are being hampered in their investigation because some people have decided not to talk with detectives because of the attention the case has received.

Two officers from the Boulder, Colo. police department were dispatched to Charlotte, North Carolina this week following the arrest there of John Brewer Eustice because of similarities in a case for which he was arrested and that of of JonBenet.
But police were able "to conclusively rule him out as a suspect," a statement released by the city of Boulder said.
No arrests have been made and no suspects named in the investigation, despite more than 200 interviews.
The little girl's body was found Dec. 26 by her father in the basement of the family's home in Boulder about eight hours after her mother said she found a ransom note demanding $118,000.
